notes.content: Students must earn a "C-" grade or higher in all courses required in the major. Foreign Language Graduation Requirement Exemption: Students graduating with a BS in Computer Engineering will not be subject to the University’s Foreign Language Graduation Requirement. Students who change major may be subject to the University’s Foreign Language Graduation Requirement. Students are expected to satisfy the general education requirements of the Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology (ABET) as well as the University's General Education requirements. For additional information, please visit: Computer Engineering .
